snippet.title: DateBoy - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4022300/DateBoy/

It's out! The video game is out! For free! On Steam!

DateBoy involves playing on a GameB--- a generic-retro-handheld-video-game-console*** while on a DATE. Hence, DateBoy. DATE. BOY. Get it? DateBoy.

Kotaku on DateBoy: https://kotaku.com/dateboy-free-steam-games-narrative-anton-henri-patsi-2000637633

CREW
Designed by Anton & Henri Pätsi
Produced by Silakka Entertainment
Programmed by Henri Pätsi
Writing & Art by Anton Pätsi
Script Edited by Victoria Learn & Julia Hogg

CAST
Date - Celina Liu
Player - Anton
Waiter - Victoria
French Couple - Anton & Julia
